Subject: Pilot discount & packaging: request for 12-month fixed-rate pilot

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo last week — CardioAI is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the VPC/private deployment options. We have an internal budget constraint for Q1 and are evaluating two vendors. To get to an internal decision, we need a commercial window that's risk-limited for us:

- 12-month pilot, fixed monthly spend covering up to 200M tokens/month
- Starter discount of 40% off list token rate for pilot (we'd internalize over first 12 months)
- One-time onboarding credit request of $25k for integration (SOW attached)
- Need data retention and audit clause: 1 year of logs retained, SOC 2 evidence requested

We can sign by 30 Nov if terms are acceptable. Can you confirm if Redwood can do the 40% and the onboarding credit? Also need a rough ARR math so we can approve the budget.

I've attached our RFP and SOW draft.

Thanks,

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear ask and the RFP. Quick note: we can support the VPC and will provide SOC2 artifacts during diligence.

Internally I'm routing for commercial approval — CardioAI is asking for (-) 40% starter discount + $25k onboarding credit. Rough economics: at list, 200M tokens/mo ~ $30k/mo => list ARR ~$360k; at 40% discount that's ~$216k ARR. If we accept the 40% + onboarding credit the short-term margin pressure is meaningful.

Internal team: marissa/jonas/kimberly — pls advise whether we can grant 40% for a 12-month pilot or propose a fallback (e.g., 28% starter + commitment to 24 months with step-down pricing). I recommend we consider a conditional approval tied to (a) 18-month minimum extension OR (b) 3-mo prepayment and audit clause.

Customer — my ask is to get internal clearance today so we can share a DocuSign package. Lisa — would CardioAI be open to a compromise (28% with 18-month extension)?

Thanks,
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Chloe — thanks for flagging. High-level view: CardioAI looks strategic (healthcare vertical + potential enterprise expansion). I am comfortable with an initial concession but we should not set a precedent for 40% on a 12-month pilot.

Proposal for approval path:
- Approve up to 28% starter discount for 12 months, conditional on:
  * 18-month contractual commitment OR signed MSA to auto-extend 12->18 months once usage thresholds hit 70% of committed tokens
  * 3 months prepayment applied to onboarding/first invoices
  * No change to audit & retention clauses (SOC2 artifacts provided)
- Approve onboarding credit capped at $15k (not $25k) and payable only if customer signs the 18-month extension
- Include a usage-based true-up after month 6

Marissa/Kimberly: please confirm commercial and finance acceptance; if you OK, we'll present to Lisa as "conditional executive exception" and route DocuSign.

-Jonas

Team — after reviewing Product and Finance modeling, I can approve an exception with the following firm controls:

- Approve 28% discount on committed token list rate for the pilot period, limited to the initial committed bucket (200M tokens/mo).
- Approve $15,000 onboarding credit, payable on execution of SOW and only released if CardioAI executes the 18-month extension within 90 days after month 12.
- Require prepayment for the first 3 months at the discounted rate (applied as credit to invoices) and a mutual audit clause with 12-month retention.
- Require legal to add a clawback: if customer churns before 18 months without cause, Redwood may invoice pro rata of the onboarding credit.

Conditions above must be captured in the DocuSign package. Route to Legal for T&Cs (I copied Marcus for Legal intake). With those controls I'm fine signing off — mark deal_id RDW-CA-2987 and proceed.

Kimberly Park
